Chapter I

Find any book. Even in airplane mode.

The whole catalogue lives on your phone, built from Open Library, Wikidata and national libraries from Finland to Korea. Search forgives typos and finds titles, authors, series and ISBNs as you type.

English comes built in. Other languages download once.

Chapter II

Read your own files.

Open books from any app or import whole folders. Highlight, take notes, tune type, spacing and margins, turn pages with volume keys, switch to paper or night pages.

  • EPUB
  • MOBI
  • AZW3
  • PDF
  • FB2
  • CBZ
  • CBR
  • CB7
  • DOCX
  • ODT
  • RTF
  • HTML
  • TXT
  • MD

Chapter III

Listen in the car, on a walk, in bed.

Play your own audiobooks with chapters, or let your phone read any ebook aloud with voices that run on the device. Android Auto shows your covers, chapters and voice search.

  • MP3
  • M4B
  • M4A
  • OGG
  • Opus
  • FLAC
  • WAV

Chapter IV

Keep the streak. Replay the year.

Set a daily goal and watch the week fill up. Monthly stats show how you read, and at the end of the year Shelf tells it back as stories, with a card to share.

Chapter V

Your next read, picked on your phone.

Browse genres, follow series and authors, and get recommendations worked out from what you read, on the device. Sort everything into lists and filter for what's ready to read.

Chapter VI

Point at a cover. Done.

Hold a book up to the camera and Shelf recognizes it on your phone. Barcodes and QR codes work too. No frame ever leaves the device.

Switch from Goodreads

Import shelves, ratings and read dates from Goodreads or StoryGraph CSV.

A cover for every book

Missing covers are drawn on your phone in the style of the genre.

Backups you own

Daily backups to any folder, CSV export, highlights as Markdown.

Tablets too

Wide screens show the book beside the list.

Private by design

  • No accounts, ads or trackers. Nothing to sell, no reason to know you.
  • Silent first launch. No request until you ask for one.
  • One switch cuts every network request.
  • On-device scanning and recommendations.
  • MIT licensed. Every line is on GitHub.

Questions

Is Shelf really free?

Yes. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription. Open source under MIT.

Do I need internet?

No. English comes built in, other languages download once. Covers load online only if you allow it.

Which languages?

The app speaks English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Eesti, Svenska, Polski, Čeština, 한국어, Suomi, 日本語, Latviešu, Português, Русский, Italiano and Nederlands. Help translate.

Can I move my library to a new phone?

Yes. Back up to a folder (a Syncthing folder works well) or export everything, then restore on the new phone.
